messages:
Lina (Partnerships): FYI Diego--Acme Integrations wants a joint pilot next month. They need EU-only hosting, SSO + SCIM, and an estimated demo cost. can we sketch a plan?
Diego (Integrator Lead): key asks: ingest enterprise PDFs (avg 80KB), embeddings -> semantic search, highlight PII redaction flow. start date flexible but aiming for ~3 weeks from now.
Sam (Solutions Eng): for EU-only we can do Dedicated or Private. what's the expected concurrency during demo?
Diego (Integrator Lead): demo load ~10 rps search, ingest steady ~300 docs/day. They also want deterministic latency for SLA demo.
Ivy (Cloud Provisioning): provisioning note: dedicated EU pool typical lead time 6 business days. Private deploy (VPC) 12-15 days due to network certs. We can request expedited but need exec approval.
Ben (AE): can marketing show a cost ballpark to procurement? need hosted vs dedicated vs private numbers, and a short note on what breaks if we go hosted.
Sam (Solutions Eng): quick numbers: hosted POC (metered) est $0.05/token for embeddings and $0.02/token for generation; for this workload ~ $150/day peak. Dedicated tiny pool (1 GPU) committed monthly ~$2k -> prorate for 3 weeks ~$1.5k + infra egress. Private on-prem is custom.
Marta (Security): they require DPA + EU data residency + proof of encryption in transit/rest. also need confirmation on key control: do they require customer-managed keys?
Diego (Integrator Lead): yes CMEK requested, but they might insist on BYOK if procurement pushes.
ComplianceBot: checklist generated: DPA template, SOC2 summary, penetration test report, vendor risk form. Missing: export control statement, encryption architecture diagram.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll draft an architecture diagram (high-level) showing: 1) Azure EU -> VPC peering -> Redwood Dedicated in eu-west 2) CMEK via customer KMS 3) prefix KV cache + batching.
Omar (DevRel): sending sample ingest script and a small demo repo for them to run locally during prep.
Sam (Solutions Eng): sample ingest curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/documents/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_TOKEN" \
  -F file=@contract.pdf \
  -F metadata='{"client_id":"acme-123"}'
```
Marta (Security): redaction note: we recommend applying PII scrub at ingest using our lightweight SDK before embeddings to avoid storing raw PHI. include the SDK snippet in runbook.
Omar (DevRel): SDK snippet: ```python
from redwood import scrub, embed, index
clean = scrub('/tmp/contract.pdf')
vec = embed(clean)
index(vec)
```
Diego (Integrator Lead): about SSO: they use Okta. we need SAML config, SCIM provisioning, and group mappings. Also audit logs to be forwarded to their Splunk instance.
Ivy (Cloud Provisioning): for Splunk forwarding we can set up a secure forwarder; need their collector endpoint and token. also for VPC peering need subscription ID and allowed CIDR.
Sam (Solutions Eng): SAML snippet for Okta: ```
ACS: https://console.redwood.ai/sso/acs/eu
EntityID: redwood-eu-acme
Attributes: email, given_name, family_name, groups
```
Ben (AE): timeline ask from customer: they want a 2-week trial window post-provisioning. what are our recommended demo windows and any throttles?
Sam (Solutions Eng): recommend 14-day demo window. if hosted: throttle to 10k tokens/day. if dedicated: no throttles but monitor burst policy. include KV cache primers in runbook.
Marta (Security): retention policy default 90 days; we can configure to 30 days for the POC. note that shorter retention affects debugging/traceability. confirm with customer.
Diego (Integrator Lead): procurement will want a one-pager: three options, costs, lead times, and what security docs they get. can someone prepare?
Lina (Partnerships): I'll put together the one-pager. Sam/Marta/Ivy please drop final numbers by EOD tomorrow.
ComplianceBot: prefilled responses: encryption_rest: AES-256, kms_options: customer CMEK via Azure Key Vault or Redwood-managed KMS, logging: audit trails + Splunk forwarding supported, soc2: available.
Ivy (Cloud Provisioning): blocker: expedited dedicated provisioning requires approval token from infra-ops Slack channel. I'll queue request once Diego confirms firm start date.
Sam (Solutions Eng): performance note: ran a quick test on sample 80KB docs: embed time ~0.9s/doc, search p95 ~220ms at 10 rps with small cache. will attach perf log to internal link.
Ben (AE): good. Diego, once you confirm start date and Splunk endpoint, I'll draft the quote and attach the one-pager.
Diego (Integrator Lead): aiming to start in 21 days. Slack me the infra ticket I need to fill.
Lina (Partnerships): action items: Diego share subscription + Splunk, Sam attach perf logs + arch diagram, Marta attach redaction SDK and security pack, Ivy prepare infra ticket template, Lina assemble one-pager and send to Diego and Acme procurement. Thanks team :rocket:
